_comment: Subway 'Finals Week' scripted demo flow (see docs QSR note). Gated to SUBWAY_PHONE. Swap the placeholder cdn.whatscraft.local banner URLs for your hosted v0–v4 images. Copy/steps are data-only; edit freely. Engine: src/scriptedFlow.js.

onEnter.caption:
Amit — Finals Week is live 🏏 HQ's default offer: 20% off any 6-inch Sub, across all outlets, all week.

Here's your store's version — ready to send as-is, or tap Edit to make it yours.

onEnter.body: What would you like to do?

reask.body: Tap Edit to make it yours, or Send as-is.

onEnter.text: Sent as-is ✅ Finals Week offer queued to your opted-in lists (Office 400 · College 400) from Subway's official number. 🏏
Sure — tell me what you'd like to change, or describe the offer you want.
Good call — combos do better during Finals Week. Building it now… ⏳

onEnter.caption: Chicken Tikka Sub + Cookie + Cold Drink 🥤🍪

onEnter.body: For pricing: Sub + Cookie + Drink separately run ₹350. I'd suggest ₹250 for the combo — nearby outlets running this combo this week are converting best at that price point, better than combos priced higher. Want to go with ₹250?

reask.body: Tap ✅ Yes, ₹250 to lock the combo price, or ✏️ Different price.

onEnter.body: No problem — for this demo I'd recommend ₹250 (best-converting this week). Shall I go with it?

onEnter.text: Done ✅ ₹350 struck through, ₹250 highlighted, cricket-ball motif added to the corner.

onEnter.caption: Here's your preview — how's this looking?

onEnter.body:
I can't label the combo gluten-free as it stands — the regular sub roll has wheat, so that'd be a false claim and an allergen-compliance risk. Three accurate ways to still win the gym crowd:

🥖 Swap to GF base — rebuild the sub on our approved gluten-free bread, then the tag is genuinely accurate.
🥗 Feature Veggie Delite — highlight the salad instead, tagged "Lighter option".
💪 High-Protein badge — keep the sub, add "High Protein • Loaded with Veggies", no bread claim.

Which one?

reask.body: Tap one of the accurate options — Swap to GF base, Veggie Delite, or High-Protein.

onEnter.text: On it ✅ Sub rebuilt on the gluten-free base — heads up though, the cookie in this combo still has gluten, so I can't tag the whole combo gluten-free. Tag now reads "SUB MADE ON GLUTEN-FREE BREAD" — accurate, and still speaks to the same crowd.
🔥 Ek strip add kar diya: "First 20 guests: EXTRA 10% OFF — show this on WhatsApp," neeche compliant fine print ke saath — "Finals Week only • dine-in & takeaway • first 20 guests only."

onEnter.body:

🔀 Dono

onEnter.text: Ho gaya ✅ Gluten-free sub, match-day price, aur extra-20 wala hook — sab ek banner mein, kickoff ke liye ready. 🏏
